experiment: E12-B Lightweight Illumination-Adaptive Multi-Level Fusion Screening
stage: representation-side lightweight adaptation (new axis after frozen-feature scoring search CLOSED)
thesis_served: P4-A1 block9+final 的弱稳定正收益能否通过 normal-only illumination-adaptive fusion 转化成可发表的小改进
why_now: P4-A1 block9+final 在 Bird/Car/Cube 3/3 AUROC positive（mean dAUROC ~ +0.0078），是 frozen-feature 搜索中最有价值的残余正信号；但 AP 不理想

exit.HOLD: 保留一个候选，下一轮小验证
exit.NO_SURVIVOR: 关闭 adaptive fusion，转 training-based representation axis

frozen_inputs.bank: 300 normal samples/category (E7-1 seed-0 frozen bank, random.Random(20261009+0).sample(1200 pool, 300))
frozen_inputs.features: block9 (l9) + final layer (l11) patch tokens, get_intermediate_layers(n=5, norm=True), 448 input, 1024 patches/image, CLS excluded
frozen_inputs.scoring: fixed E11 baseline 1-NN-max (L2-normalised cosine NN -> max over 1024 patches)
frozen_inputs.test_set: identical to E11-P4/P5: Bird/Car/Cube view120 (700 img), official image_anomaly + raw boolean detectable filter
frozen_inputs.labels: official image_anomaly + raw boolean detectable (no test-label tuning)

S3.name: Channel Gate
S3.op: f = lam .* norm(f9) + (1-lam) .* norm(ffinal), lam=sigmoid(theta) in R^768, +identity/L2 reg

S4.name: Sample-Adaptive Two-Scale SE Gate
S4.op: input=concat(global_avg_pool(f9), global_avg_pool(ffinal)) in R^1536 -> MLP(1536->48->2) -> softmax[w9,wfinal] -> f=w9*norm(f9)+wfinal*norm(ffinal)

resolved_ambiguities.A_identity_reference: L_identity anchor = fixed equal-weight sum F_ref = normalize(0.5*n(f9)+0.5*n(ffinal)) in R^768 (NOT the 1536-d concat, which is dimension-incompatible with the sum-family output). F_ref == the gate initialization point, so L_identity==0 at init.
resolved_ambiguities.C_s4_gate_input: per-sample (image being scored): global mean-pooled raw LayerNorm'd block9 + final features, concat -> R^1536
resolved_ambiguities.contrast_impl: NEW (history only had brightness/gamma): linear contrast (t-0.5)*level+0.5, clamped [0,1]

illumination_augmentation.severity: mild +/-10% (levels 0.9, 1.1), consistent with E7-AO-Q3 mild convention

normal_only_training.train_val_split: bank 300 normals -> train 240 / val 60 (fixed, sorted image path order)
normal_only_training.L_consistency: 1 - cosine(F_fused(x), F_fused(T_illum(x))), per-patch mean (patch correspondence preserved)
normal_only_training.L_identity: squared L2 distance(F_fused(x), F_ref(x)), per-patch mean (F_ref = equal-weight sum)

training_budget.early_stopping: val consistency no improvement for 20 steps (evaluated every 5 steps)

decision_rules.KEEP: mean dAUROC >= +0.010 AND positive categories >= 2/3 AND worst dAUROC >= -0.010 AND mean dAP >= 0; AND complexity gate vs S1: (A) mean dAUROC >= S1 + 0.003 OR (B) mean dAP >= S1 + 0.010 AND mean dAUROC >= S1 - 0.002
decision_rules.HOLD: mean dAUROC >= +0.005 AND 3/3 dAUROC >= 0 AND mean dAP >= -0.005

not_allowed_rescue: NO SURVIVOR -> immediately close axis; do NOT tune lr/hidden-dim/augmentation-strength to rescue
